title: SanForum · choose the theme direction
question: Compare the mobile forum concepts. Each preserves the logo and blue accents, gives categories and recent discussions equal prominence, and extends to topics, search, composer and profiles. Select a direction or steer the next round.

options.label: Kursplan
options.thesis: A precise, compact rhythm makes categories and live discussion equally easy to scan.
options.viewport: Mobile Discourse header, equal category and discussion headings, a short category index and topic rows with a shared activity column.
options.risk: Can feel too dense if spacing and wrapping are not carefully tuned.

raised.raise: Unread and selected states remain understandable without colour alone.
Metadata follows a stable hierarchy across overview, search and profile activity.
Location and return paths stay visible while moving between category and discussion.
Categories and discussions each get a clearly bounded work area.
One alignment system governs every screen, including dense and quiet states.

options.label: Fachjournal
options.thesis: Clear reading hierarchy gives the community’s conversations room without turning the forum into a magazine.
options.viewport: Mobile forum header, equally prominent category browsing and recent activity, readable topic titles with restrained summaries and metadata.
options.risk: The most familiar direction; distinction depends on excellent typography and restraint.
options.lineage: Professional journals and their correspondence sections

options.label: Wissensregister
options.thesis: A strong blue section marker makes every discussion feel located within a shared body of knowledge.
options.viewport: Standard mobile Discourse navigation, a category index and topic list; a single offset blue tab marks the active section.
options.risk: The tab motif must remain a quiet orientation aid, never turn into a simulated book.
options.lineage: Tabbed reference manuals, translated to a working forum
options.case: Audience identification: strong training/reference association. Product clarity: comparable to Kursplan, with more emphasis on orientation.

options.label: Emission rail
options.thesis: Topic state expressed through line weight beside a stable reading rail.
options.viewport: A conventional forum list with precise state markers.
options.risk: Hairline detail and uniform type would weaken mobile scanning.
options.case: Audience identification: weaker than Kursplan. Product clarity: weaker at phone scale.
options.kept: State must remain clear without colour.

options.label: Ticket wallet
options.thesis: Each conversation has a compact, consistent metadata block.
options.viewport: Standard forum navigation and stacked topic rows with aligned metadata.
options.risk: Travel-ticket cues add an unrelated association.
options.case: Audience identification: weaker than Kursplan. Product clarity: boxed metadata overcomplicates long titles.

options.label: Orienteering map
options.thesis: Strong location cues keep categories and conversations connected.
options.viewport: Standard topic lists with visible category and return context.
options.risk: A map metaphor would obscure ordinary forum navigation.
options.case: Audience identification: relevant to only part of the community. Product clarity: weaker than the direct course rhythm.

options.label: Garden guide
options.thesis: Distinct work areas separate category browsing from recent activity.
options.viewport: Conventional forum work areas with a bolder boundary treatment.
options.risk: Organic shapes compete with dense text.
options.case: Audience identification: weak. Product clarity: weaker than Kursplan for text-heavy discussions.

options.label: Crouwel grid
options.thesis: Consistent alignment brings discipline to the full theme.
options.viewport: A standard category index and discussion list on a precise grid.
options.risk: Visible construction grids and oversized type would crowd the content.
options.case: Audience identification: weak. Product clarity: weaker if the grid becomes the subject.
options.kept: A shared alignment system across every screen.

canonCard.label: Familiar Discourse
canonCard.thesis: The familiar Discourse layout, carefully tuned for SanForum.
canonCard.viewport: Standard mobile forum header, categories and recent topics with equal access and conventional rows.
canonCard.risk: The least distinctive choice; recognition rests mainly on the existing logo and blue.
